hypothesis: Durable ARC-R018 evidence is sufficient to determine whether selector error or candidate-set omission is the dominant cause of parseable treatment failures.
primary_variable: evidence audit only; no target-model calls and no solver change
finding: The requested candidate-coverage versus selector-error distinction is not identifiable from the durable ARC-R018 artifacts because the runner persisted only stage metadata and selected_index, not the three candidate grids/rules or an oracle candidate-correctness vector.
identifiability_reason: parse_hypotheses() holds three rules/test_output grids in memory, but run() persists only candidate parsed/token/runtime/finish metadata; selector persistence includes selected_index only. Therefore exact scoring can tell whether the selected grid was wrong, but cannot tell whether an unselected candidate grid was correct.
adversarial_interpretation: A wrong selected output does not imply selector error: all three generated candidates may be wrong. Conversely, selector success/failure cannot be inferred from selected_index alone. Any stronger retrospective classification would fabricate evidence that ARC-R018 did not persist.

successor_experiment.name: candidate-oracle-instrumentation-v1
successor_experiment.falsifiable_hypothesis: On the same frozen eight-task dev_validation slice, persisting and exact-scoring all three generated candidate grids before selection will show whether candidate-set coverage is at least 50% on the four parseable ARC-R018 failures; if coverage is below 50%, candidate generation/representation is the dominant bottleneck, otherwise selector/ranking is the dominant bottleneck.
successor_experiment.design: Keep model, candidate prompt, selector prompt, sampling, task IDs and budgets fixed. Change only instrumentation so each parsed candidate grid is exact-scored against the already-authorized public-training-derived test output and persisted with candidate_correct flags plus selected_index. Reuse cache where possible; do not use public evaluation.
successor_experiment.decision_rule: Among parseable failure tasks, candidate-set coverage < 50% => prioritize generator/representation; coverage >= 50% with selected candidate wrong => prioritize selector/ranking.

verdict_scope: The audit succeeds in identifying a measurement blind spot but cannot honestly classify candidate omission versus selector mistakes from existing evidence.
